video_title: Cooper Flagg & Max Christie Postgame | Mavericks at Suns | Nov. 27, 2026

quotes.speaker: Cooper Flagg
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg and Max Christie on team resilience and chemistry
quotes.excerpt: just staying together and trusting the game plan, trusting each other

text_blocks.speaker: Cooper Flagg
text_blocks.text: I think just staying together. It's something we talked about all year long, but just staying together and trusting the game plan, trusting each other. Dallas just making big-time winning plays.

text_blocks.speaker: Max Christie
text_blocks.text: I think just being able to battle through and win a tough game down the stretch without arguably one of the best closers in this game has ever seen. So I think just showing that resilience, the togetherness, just fighting through some adversity.

quotes.social_post: Cooper Flagg on the team win against the Suns: staying together and trusting the game plan was key to battling through adversity down the stretch.

structured.context: Cooper Flagg discusses the team's resilience and ability to win a close game despite missing a key player.

quotes.speaker: Max Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: Max Christie on his high-level impact in the fourth quarter
quotes.excerpt: for him just to come in there and impact the game at such a high level
quotes.quote: Max just stayed ready all year long and for him just to come in there and impact the game at such a high level, obviously iced the game with the free throws down the stretch, knocked down three, the mid-range he hit. Just to come in and affect the game at such a high level, obviously showing that he's just going to stay ready and he was a really big part of that.
quotes.social_post: Cooper Flagg praises Max Christie for staying ready all year and making high level plays to help ice the game in the fourth quarter.

structured.context: Cooper Flagg praises Max Christie for his high-level performance and impact during the fourth quarter of the game.

quotes.speaker: Cooper Flagg
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg on defensive identity and disrupting offensive rhythm
quotes.excerpt: just continuing to get steals and deflections, that's one of our biggest identities as a team
quotes.quote: Just continuing to get steals and deflections, that's one of our biggest identities as a team, something we've continued to harp on. The coaching staff has and us as players, we just want to just disrupt team's offensive rhythm. They got a lot of great players, a lot of tough shot-makers, but I think our length, our ability to be in passing lanes, get deflections, get steals, run out for easy baskets helped us to kind of win the game.
quotes.social_post: Cooper Flagg says the defensive identity of the team is built on getting steals and deflections to disrupt the offensive rhythm of opponents.

structured.context: Cooper Flagg explains how the team's defensive focus on deflections and steals helped them disrupt the opponent's rhythm.

quotes.speaker: Cooper Flagg
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg on maintaining confidence and a positive team culture
quotes.excerpt: I'm not searching for anything, I'm just going to continue to stay ready behind the scenes
quotes.quote: I'm always just confident in my game. I'm not searching for anything, I'm just going to continue to stay ready behind the scenes. It felt pretty cool to see a game like this kind of come to fruition, just really staying at it every single day, trying to keep a positive attitude. At the end of the day, we were winning games, so I really had no reason to be upset. I'm living my dream every day and we got a great team, a great group of guys that get along really well.
quotes.social_post: Cooper Flagg on his mindset: I am always confident in my game and just trying to keep a positive attitude because I am living my dream every day.

structured.context: Cooper Flagg reflects on maintaining a positive attitude and confidence while working behind the scenes for the team.

quotes.speaker: Cooper Flagg
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg on the competitive atmosphere of the Cup games
quotes.excerpt: the Cup is really interesting for the season where it just adds another level of competition
quotes.quote: The Cup is really interesting for the season where it just adds another level of competition and guys really want to win it. So I think just adding that pressure on some of these early-season games is a true test to kind of what some of these games could feel like towards the end of the season. I'm looking forward to just being able to compete at such a high level and continue to win some of these close games.
quotes.social_post: Cooper Flagg says the NBA Cup adds another level of competition and pressure to early season games that serves as a test for the end of the season.

structured.context: Cooper Flagg shares his thoughts on how the NBA Cup adds a higher level of competition and pressure to early-season games.

quotes.speaker: Max Christie
quotes.summary_phrase: Max Christie on the playoff-like atmosphere of the Cup
quotes.excerpt: the overall intensity and vibe of the game feels playoff-esque
quotes.quote: It just kind of raises the atmosphere, the overall intensity and vibe of the game feels playoff-esque. We're coming into each game as well as a team and as a staff with a little bit of an extra edge, knowing that something kind of bigger is on the line. It's another way to compete at a higher level, being able to be in situations where stakes are a little bit higher than a typical regular-season game.
quotes.social_post: Max Christie says the NBA Cup games feel playoff esque because the team and staff approach them with an extra edge knowing something bigger is on the line.

structured.context: Max Christie describes how the NBA Cup games create a more intense, playoff-like atmosphere for the team.

quotes.speaker: Cooper Flagg
quotes.summary_phrase: Cooper Flagg on the impact of team leadership and management
quotes.excerpt: being able to have new leadership like that and they're very present in every single game
quotes.quote: It's pretty special, being able to have new leadership like that and they're very present in every single game for us, good or bad. That's something I think as players we appreciate for sure, being able to know that our leadership has our backs regardless. It shows that they came in and they wanted to create a new culture and them just being there and supporting us and showing the level of excitement, it really does mean something.
quotes.social_post: Cooper Flagg says the players appreciate having leadership that is present at every game and shows they have the team's back regardless of the outcome.

structured.context: Cooper Flagg discusses how the team appreciates the presence and support of the new leadership group.
